label: late original-phase input s, in sequences starting with r
explanation: Sparse feature that fires only in the original phase (96%) and at the delimiter (4%), never during copy, at steps t=4..9 (peak t=6-7, near the end of the input). Input s carries 75% of activation mass (20x lift). Magnitude is strongly modulated by the first original token being r (69% of mass, 19x lift; n is a weak second). The top activations are all r ... s near the end of the input, especially when the second token is n or x (precision 0.85 for that subset, but low recall). On dev, s & t>=5 & first_tok r reaches precision 0.41, recall 0.25, F1 0.31 and mass recall 0.44. Dropping the r condition gives mass recall 0.73 but precision 0.03. The predicate misses many weak activations: s late in sequences that start with other letters, a few non-s tokens, and DEL steps. Not active on early steps (t<4), on any copy-phase step, or on most s inputs without a leading r.

scorecard.summary: Weighted combination of 40 cues. Raise it: orig0=r (+6.15), orig1=n (+3.77), orig2=s (+3.20), orig0=n (+3.16), phase=0 & in_tok=s (+3.03), recall_idx=-1 & in_tok=s (+3.03). Lower it: prev3_tok=- (-6.19), phase=2 (-4.05), t=4 (-3.40), t=3 (-3.14).
